SELECT
                    o.id,
                    s.store_name AS store_name,
                    u.firstname AS first_name,
                    u.lastname AS last_name,
                    u.email AS email,
                    u.telephone AS telephone,
                    nf.feedback_answer AS feedback,
                    nf.question_id AS question_id,
                    nq.question AS question,
                    nf.created_at AS feedback_date,
                    o.created_at AS order_date
                FROM
                    nps_feedback nf
                        LEFT JOIN
                    orders o ON o.id = nf.order_id
                        LEFT JOIN
                    order_stores os ON o.id = os.order_id
                        LEFT JOIN
                    stores s ON s.id = os.store_id
                        LEFT JOIN
                    users u ON u.id = o.user_id
                        LEFT JOIN
                    nps_questions nq ON nq.id = nf.question_id
                WHERE
                    nf.order_id > 0

         And o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-01 23:59:00'  order by o.id desc
